_meta.methodology: Reviewed current official San Francisco Recreation and Parks facility pages and the current Fitness2Function operator site. Individual outdoor apparatus nodes are represented by four parent public facilities. No forms, accounts, authentication, contact data, or payment data were used.

gyms.name: Golden Gate Park Fitness Course
gyms.address: Golden Gate Park, San Francisco, CA 94122
gyms.priceNote: Free public park fitness course. Individual exercise stations are retained as source evidence rather than published as separate gyms.

gyms.name: Mountain Lake Park Fitness Circuit
gyms.address: 12th Avenue and Lake Street, San Francisco, CA 94118
gyms.priceNote: Free public built-in fitness circuit. Individual exercise stations are retained as source evidence rather than published as separate gyms.

gyms.name: Marina Green Park Fitness Area
gyms.address: Marina Boulevard and Fillmore Street, San Francisco, CA 94123
gyms.gymType: Public park parcourse and outdoor fitness area
gyms.priceNote: Free public parcourse workout stations around Marina Green. Exact station hours are not separately published.

gyms.name: Sunset Dunes Park Outdoor Fitness
gyms.address: Great Highway between Lincoln Way and Sloat Boulevard, San Francisco, CA 94122
gyms.priceNote: Free public outdoor fitness area. The exact hours of the park equipment are not separately published.

gyms.name: Fitness2Function
gyms.priceNote: The official rate card lists a $70 single 50-minute group session, ten group sessions for $650, a $130 single private session, and ten private sessions for $1,200. No recurring membership, mandatory fee, or package expiry is published. Fitness2Function remains distinct from the co-located Classical Pilates Studio identity.
